title: Structure Pack Trio #32 (임산부 큰 조각 4개·물결 / 임산부 굵은 스트라이프·물결 / 임산부 비대칭 몬드리안·매끈 | 이레즈미+코이비늘+스테인드글라스+목재 / 이레즈미+금박+흑요암금 / 인어비늘+금박+목재+드래곤비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Jamaican, in her early 40s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and dominating her entire middle, an enormous taut, high, rounded pregnant belly, far larger and more prominent than any ordinary pregnancy, projecting forward dramatically, the navel pushed outward on its smooth rounded surface. Enormous round hips below it, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, deep dark brown hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real pores, real living eyes, 100 studs piercings set with diamonds in silver-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of silver a necklace. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. A long hazy transition zone runs diagonally from the upper left edge of her figure to the lower right edge, as seen by the camera. A second transition zone branches off it about 41% of the way along its length and runs to the upper right edge. A third transition zone branches off it about 70% of the way along its length and runs to the lower left edge. Together the three zones divide her figure into 4 large irregular pieces. Region 1 is the piece above the long diagonal and before the second branch (the upper left): it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, orchid formations in DEEP VIOLET and EMERALD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the piece above the long diagonal and beyond the second branch (the upper right): it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the piece below the long diagonal and before the third branch (the lower left): it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 4 is the piece below the long diagonal and beyond the third branch (the lower right): it carries deep black ebony wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING glossy jet-black grain with VIVID dark-brown highlight streaks. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
